If your tracking number never updates, this can happen while the courier is still processing the package. It may take a few days after the label is created for the first scan to appear. 
What you can do:
Wait a few days after shipment for the first tracking update.
Check the tracking link regularly on the courier’s website.
If there are still no updates after several days, contact the courier directly with the tracking number to ask about the delay.
If tracking remains stalled for 3–5 business days and the courier cannot provide information, you can then follow up with us so the situation can be investigated further.
